email.subject: gg wp
email.body:
Ok, ok, I get it. Fair enough. Stop messing with my shit.
A bit sloppy leaving those logs on your box, but, seriously, it kinda looked like you had no idea what you're doing. But hey, this could all be for the best, It's not everyday you run into someone on the internet that's not a complete idiot you know.
I've got a little test for you - should be pretty fun. There's this security company that's basically a fucking joke, Nortron. Know them? Yeah, tbh i'd rather have a virus than their "security" shit clogging up my system. It's totally trash. They make most of their sales from people who have no idea what they are doing.
I've been meaning to fuck with their website for a while now - basically just plater the word "dicks" all over it. Dicks in the title, on the header, I dont even care if you change the whole website to just be the single word DICKS, really. If you're into a little Hacktivism for hilarity, let me see what you've got. Surely that'll be more fun than whatever you were originally here for, right?
-Naix
P.S: You probably have no idea what real security is still, so I gave you a link to baby's first hacking guide too. Have fun!

attachments.note: Replace something in the title with "DICKS". I'll also condone other changes, as long as they're hilarious.
